claims.quote: The Archive smelled of vellum and cold dust — everything there kept its breath low.

claims.value: full Folio kept in Archive; only staff and supervised apprentices may handle it; thin foliolist posted; removal of pages requires two witnesses and an entry in the Archive register
claims.quote: "Full Folio is kept in the Archive; only staff and supervised apprentices may handle it." ... The Folio's presence was public enough for us to see it; the Archive would take the book later... The house kept the ledger room under strict watch: two locks, a register at the door, and an expectation that removal of folio pages required two witnesses and an entry in the Archive register.

claims.value: fetching pages, holding the lamp, wiping folio edges, copying entries into foliolist
claims.quote: My job was thin but steady: fetch a page, hold the lamp, wipe a smudge, copy a single address into the day's foliolist.
Over months I proved careful with ink and order; a junior Archivist granted me supervised access to consult older margins.

claims.value: (child present); * petition deferred; — vanished (no trace); (entry redacted)
claims.quote: Some notes were thin and explanatory — "(child present)" or "* petition deferred" — small, bureaucratic and indifferent. ... I saw a small cluster of shorthand that made the air in my chest go colder: "— vanished (no trace)."

claims.value: a bunk stripped bare with no trunk at its foot
claims.quote: I saw such a bunk — a bunk a few rows down had been stripped bare; no trunk stood at its foot.

claims.value: two locks and a register at the door
claims.quote: The house kept the ledger room under strict watch: two locks, a register at the door, and an expectation that removal of folio pages required two witnesses and an entry in the Archive register.

claims.value: place where girls speak more freely and where Rue goes to think and run errands
claims.quote: I ran errands into the Garden sometimes, carrying forms that smelled of vellum and damp earth. The Garden was where we could breathe and say louder things in safer company.
